info.title: Centralised Package Management Converter
info.description: Dotnet tool to convert large solutions to/from centralised package management

options.name: --revert
options.description:
Revert from Centralised Package Management to
project-file-based versions.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Read-only mode (make no changes on disk).

options.name: -f
options.description:
Force changes (don't prompt/check for permission
before continuing).

options.name: -m
options.description: Merge changes with existing directory file

options.name: --encoding
options.description:
Encoding of written files, IANA web name (e.g.
'utf-8', 'utf-16'). Default is picked by .NET
implementation.

options.name: --linewrap
options.description:
Line wrap style: 'lf'=Unix, 'crlf'=Windows,
'cr'=Mac. Default is system style.

options.name: --min-version
options.description:
Pick minimum instead of maximum package version
number.

options.name: --version-comparison
options.description:
Which NuGet version parts to consider (enum
VersionComparison): Default, Version,
VersionRelease, VersionReleaseMetadata

options.name: --exclude-dirs
options.description:
(Default: ^\.|^bin$|^obj$) Exclude directories
matching this regular expression (not search
pattern!)

arguments.name: Root Directory
arguments.description: Root folder to scan for project files.
